body: Long-context inference and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) handle evidence selection at vastly different scales, from a single long prompt to an entire corpus. We ask whether a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across this range. We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue. Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval's F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.

summaryZh: 本文介绍了UNREAL（UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model），这是一种将语料库检索与长上下文推理统一的模型原生证据选择框架。该方法直接从冻结的大模型的内部表示中编码块并派生检索查询，仅增加不到50K个可训练参数。在维基百科大规模索引测试中，UNREAL在多个问答基准上大幅超越了现有的检索-重排系统，并在长上下文任务中去除了干扰因素、降低了计算复杂度。

glossary.explanationZh: 检索增强生成，通过外部知识库检索来为大模型生成提供准确事实依据的技术。
长上下文推理，指大模型处理和理解超长文本输入的能力。
证据选择，指从大量文本或语料库中挑选出对回答问题真正有用的片段的过程。
稠密与混合检索，结合向量嵌入和传统检索方式的技术路线。
浮点运算次数，衡量计算复杂度和硬件开销的核心指标。
